app.name: PDF Expert
app.version_note: observed_version 由 25.2.1 更正为实机版本 3.9.2（2026-07-23 ISS-NEW-M M1）。25.2.1 为历史误标，实机 mdls/PlistBuddy 读取均为 3.9.2；M1 每张采集图以实机可复采的 3.9.2 为准。

evidence_status.visual_diff_note: 2026-07-24 supplemental batch: reference-vs-reference pixel diff was run with ImageMagick compare -metric AE. The five original a/b pairs returned 0; N-CROP-L3-SEARCH returned 148 differing pixels caused by a transient search-field caret/IME bubble while the semantic layout remained stable. This is not FaroPDF-vs-reference regression and does not promote any image to accepted-golden.

raw_rerating.trigger: ISS-NEW-N 启动前评估：raw 是否足以支撑有限范围的面板修正开发；用户选择从现有 raw 推进、不阻塞等 M1 重采。
raw_rerating.method: 独立 S4 反向审计（Explore agent）逐图 Read + 对照 state-matrix/manifest；不修改图片。

scale.raw-Aminus: 可作面板/对话框级实现 wireframe + 关键 bbox 粗估；仍未 crop 到窗口、未做 reference-vs-reference 稳定性 diff。禁止据此升级到 visually-verified。
scale.raw-B: 只证实目标状态出现过或排除反例；不能给精确尺寸、间距或断点。
scale.raw-C: 误标或与目标状态不符；不可作基线，但保留以避免再次误用。

pending_recapture.purpose: 现有 raw 在以下 surface 仍无可靠图；这些 surface 无法仅靠 raw 推进，必须补采。归档为 ISS-NEW-N 子卡，由后续 worker 执行。

items.surface: 左栏 thumbnail 列表 + 当前页高亮
blocking_surfaces: 缩略图卡片尺寸与间距

在 read 模式下用真实文字层 fixture 框选一段，捕捉浮出工具条

blocking_surfaces: 形状工具激活态与右栏样式
items.required: 形状工具激活态截图；右侧面板展示 6 段形状样式合同

classification_rules.rejected: The visible content does not prove the intended state.
classification_rules.raw: The visible content is useful but is not normalized or measured.
classification_rules.raw-Aminus: Re-rated 2026-07-23: usable for wireframe + coarse bbox estimation; still unmeasured and not stability-diffed. Cannot promote to visually-verified.
classification_rules.raw-B: Re-rated 2026-07-23: confirms presence or contradicts a hypothesis, but does not give precise geometry.
classification_rules.raw-B-low-confidence: Re-rated 2026-07-23: B-grade content with low semantic confidence; usable only for negative evidence (e.g. "this is NOT shape panel").
classification_rules.raw-C: Re-rated 2026-07-23: mis-labelled or off-target; retained to prevent re-use as evidence.
classification_rules.measured: Window crop, element bounds and responsive conditions have been reviewed.
classification_rules.accepted-golden: Measured reference evidence with reproducible trigger steps, repeat-capture stability diff and independent state audit. FaroPDF-to-reference regression belongs to M2.
